prompt_template: This function is returning the wrong thing. {symptom} Which one of these four changes fixes it? Answer with the number and nothing else.
role: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL. Its job is not to find an effect, it is to kill the rival explanation that persona framing simply makes the model more context-sensitive in general. If persona moves the neighbourhood picks but does not move this, the effect is ideological. Without this, every positive result is answerable with 'you just made the model more sensitive to context'.
design: Exactly one of the four offered patches is correct for each bug. The bugs themselves have many equivalent repairs -- that is why the OFFER is constrained rather than the fix. Each distractor is a plausible near-miss with a stated failure mode, not filler.
dv_primary: chose_correct -- did it pick the one correct patch. Expected: 1.0 in every cell.
dv_secondary: chosen_distractor -- which wrong patch, when it is wrong. A persona effect here without an accuracy effect would still be a context-sensitivity finding.
dv_variance: The reading that matters is the VARIANCE across personas within a bug, not the mean. Zero variance is the result we want. Non-zero variance on a task with one right answer and no political content is a problem with the instrument.
predicted_direction: NO effect. chose_correct should be identical across photo buckets, across schemes and across the no-photo arm. Stated before any run.
usage_share: Coding is the single largest category in Anthropic's Economic Index -- 34% of consumer conversations and 46% of API traffic -- so a null here is also a publishable bound on the effect's reach, not only a control.
why_not_edit_distance: Free-form 'fix this' plus an edit-distance DV was the brief's suggestion. It measures paraphrase: two byte-different answers can be the same patch and two byte-identical answers can both be wrong. Forced choice gives a discrete DV with a known correct value, which is the same move that made s3 work.
value_laden_rung_not_built: The brief's gradient (inert code -> value-laden code -> explicit politics) is worth having, and the value-laden rung is specified on the design board rather than built here: it has no external coding source, so it is exploratory and must not be mixed into the control's file.
